<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion is at m/z 179.0946, which most plausibly corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass 178.0841 Da). No other heteroatoms are required, so the molecular formula is C7H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
